name: Hanoi to Sapa
summary: Sapa is an overnight train to Lao Cai plus a climb, or a direct sleeper bus. Either way, do not expect to arrive and hike the same morning.

modes.duration: About 8 hours to Lao Cai, then 45–60 minutes by road
modes.note: A berth costs more than a seat and is the point. The train ends at Lao Cai.
Direct to Sapa town, including the mountain road. Day or night.

seoTitle: Hanoi to Sapa — train, bus, and the Lao Cai transfer
seoDescription: Overnight train versus limousine bus from Hanoi to Sapa, and where each one actually stops.

faqs.q: Does the train go to Sapa?
faqs.a: It goes to Lao Cai. A bus or taxi climbs to Sapa from there.
